# Budgets Requirements Checklist: Budgets (client)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of spec 012 — figure parity with the server, offline progress without jumps, period boundaries, write discipline and backend contract fidelity
**Created**: 2026-10-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Focus (assumed default, owner away): money-correctness risks (attribution, period, rounding, which figure is shown), then contract fidelity and UX completeness; standard depth; audience = PR reviewer. Items found as gaps were fixed in the spec, plan, research or contracts in the same session; each says where. Unchecked items were reviewed and hold; they stay open for the PR reviewer.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is it specified what happens to a chosen category when the person switches to a currency in which it is already budgeted? [Gap → fixed: FR-004 "Changing the currency MUST clear …"]
- [x] CHK002 Is the start day defined for the moment before the phone holds the profile? [Gap → fixed: FR-009 "until the phone holds the profile, the start day MUST be 1 …"]
- [x] CHK003 Is "days left" defined, including the period's last day? [Gap → fixed: FR-016 "end − today; 'Last day of the period'"]
- [x] CHK004 Are offline and failed refresh outcomes of the budgets screen specified? [Gap → fixed: FR-016 pull-to-refresh outcomes]
- [x] CHK005 Is the Home card defined for budgets with waiting changes and for an unknown period? [Gap → fixed: FR-017]
- [x] CHK006 Is the fate of stored server progress rows for budgets deleted elsewhere, or not yet on the phone, specified? [Gap → fixed: research R-09 "A completed walk replaces …"]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the verification gate specified for every write (create, limit, archive, delete), not only creation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 Are all six banked backend questions (attribution, currency, income budgets, overlap, archived category, where progress is served) answered for the client? [Completeness, Spec §Sources, FR-004, FR-012, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the in-use rule for categories named by budgets defined for both waiting and synced budgets? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK010 Is "the person's own expense" defined precisely enough to reproduce the server (author, kind, live, member wallet, currency, category, date)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the percentage rounding stated (nearest, half up) and is the absence of a server percentage explicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the projection formula, its rounding and its overflow cut-off stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, research R-07]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "nothing that feeds a budget has changed since the read" defined in testable terms? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, research R-06]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "pending start day change" defined by a date comparison, not by wording? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 Do the editor's immutability rules (FR-005) agree with the handler's request rule (stored members sent, research R-04) and the backend's `IMMUTABLE_FIELD`? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK016 Do the archive rules agree across spec (FR-006), contract (A3: per record) and sync (FR-019: never batched)? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK017 Does the Home ordering (highest percentage first) stay consistent with the list ordering (oldest first) without contradiction? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, FR-017]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the waiting note ("Includes changes waiting to sync") triggered by the same rule in spec FR-014 and research R-06 (b)? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Can SC-003 (parity) be checked objectively with the listed live QA set? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, quickstart]
- [ ] CHK020 Is SC-008 measurable on host with a defined data set (50 budgets, 20,000 transactions)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the integration checkpoint (SC-007) traceable to US3's independent test? [Traceability]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 Are clash, deleted-elsewhere and refused outcomes specified for limit edits, archive and delete alike? [Coverage, Spec §US4, FR-007]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the case of a budget created offline (no server progress yet) covered? [Coverage, Spec §US3-S7, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the jump-free switch from a waiting expense to an accepted one covered? [Coverage, Spec §US3-S2, research R-06]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the first sync after the update (user scope read from the start) covered? [Coverage, Spec §US6-S1, FR-020]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 Are periods for start day 28 across February and for 31-day months covered? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK027 Is a confirmation waiting on the phone for a rule authored by a partner covered? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK028 Are a viewer's own past transactions in a shared wallet covered? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases "Shared wallet"]
- [ ] CHK029 Is midnight at a period's end, with the screen open, covered? [Edge Case, Spec §US5-S6]
- [ ] CHK030 Are unknown period types from a later server covered? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, research R-15]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK031 Is the "no alarm" presentation stated as checkable rules (no exclamation, no warning icon, words and percentage always written)? [Accessibility/UX, Spec §FR-015, contracts/ui-and-e2e.md Copy]
- [ ] CHK032 Are logging limits stated (no amounts, limits, spending, projections, payloads)? [Security, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK033 Are RTL bar direction and 200% font scale required for the new screens? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-025]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK034 Are backend contract gaps listed with the client mitigation for each? [Dependencies, Spec §9]
- [ ] CHK035 Are the transactions and recurring hook additions specified as defaulted, behaviour-preserving changes? [Dependencies, contracts/budgets-domain.md]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the assumption that the phone holds every member wallet's transactions stated and its failure mode (server figure covers it) described? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, FR-014]
